mapper.select: SELECT FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID pledgeFinprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE pledgeFinprodType, FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_NUMBER pledgeNumber, FIN_PRODUCT.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT INNER JOIN FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE ON FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.FINPROD_ID /**AND FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE = FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.FINPROD_TYPE**/ AND FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.BRANCH = FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.BRANCH LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID /**AND FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE.PLEDGE_FINPROD_TYPE = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE**/ where FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE IN (#{finprodType1},#{finprodType2}) AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = #{mpFinprodId}

SELECT BOK_DETAIL_ID.BOK_DETAIL_ID bokDetailId, case when BOK_DETAIL_ID.INV_AIM='AC' then 'TYCBLCB' when BOK_DETAIL_ID.INV_AIM='FVTPL' then 'GYJZSYL_CB' when BOK_DETAIL_ID.INV_AIM='FVOCI' then 'ZHSYLCB' end as basicsSubject FROM BOK_DETAIL_ID WHERE BOK_DETAIL_ID.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND BOK_DETAIL_ID.BUSI_ID= #{busiId} AND BOK_DETAIL_ID.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE= #{busiDetailType} AND BOK_DETAIL_ID.INV_AIM IN ('AC','FVTPL','FVOCI') ORDER BY basicsSubject asc

SELECT BOK_DETAIL_ID.BOK_DETAIL_ID bokDetailId FROM BOK_DETAIL_ID WHERE BOK_DETAIL_ID.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND BOK_DETAIL_ID.BUSI_ID= #{busiId} AND BOK_DETAIL_ID.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE= #{busiDetailType} AND BOK_DETAIL_ID.INV_AIM = #{invAim}
